title: The html root element and lang
learningObjectives: Identify and assemble the parts of a complete HTML document

understand.concept: The html element is the document root. Its lang attribute identifies the primary language, such as en or te.
understand.whyItMatters: Language metadata helps screen readers pronounce content and supports text processing.
understand.analogy: A book's language label helps classify it, while lang also informs assistive technology.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a memory aid; HTML should not be interpreted literally through it.

explain.narrative: The html element is the document root. Its lang attribute identifies the primary language, such as en or te.

examples.explanation: The page shows Hello; the document language is declared as English.
examples.expectedOutput: The page shows Hello; the document language is declared as English.

practise.guidedTask: Set lang to en or te and add a heading in that language.
practise.independentTask: Create your own small page, open it in a browser and inspect the result.
hints: Check that each element is nested under the correct parent.
